_note: 104 keys, ALL of them LLM drafts. NONE has been checked by a native Tamil speaker, which is why _reviewed is empty. Same pipeline and same rule as or.json: draft -> native speaker review -> move the key into _reviewed, and never promote a key without that review. Every string here is SPOKEN to someone who cannot read it, so a confidently wrong instruction is worse than an English one. Keys absent from this file fall through to English AND ARE SPOKEN IN AN ENGLISH VOICE — resolve() in i18n/index.ts guarantees that, so a missing key degrades honestly rather than becoming English words mangled by a Tamil TTS engine. The 145 keys not drafted here are the ones outside the photo-to-listing path (publish, setup, settings, money, orders, GST); they are next, not forgotten.

consent.body: உங்கள் தொலைபேசி எண்ணை மட்டும் வைத்திருக்கிறோம். உங்கள் பான், ஆதார், வங்கிக் கணக்கு, எந்த ஆவணத்தையும் வைத்திருப்பதில்லை. எப்போது வேண்டுமானாலும் எல்லாவற்றையும் அழிக்கலாம்.
